visualCharacteristics.variantDescriptor: Large display heading (accent-colored word) left, body copy + uppercase arrow CTA right; text-only.
visualCharacteristics.sectionStylingNotes: Small uppercase eyebrow "PRIVACY CENTER" above a two-column teaser: large heading "We are transparent." (word "transparent." in green) on the left; paragraph and uppercase arrow CTA on the right.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Text-only two-column teaser: display heading left, body copy and CTA right

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 heading (may include emphasized accent word); cell 2 paragraph(s) + a link-only paragraph as CTA
contentPattern.description: Heading "We are transparent." left; paragraph + CTA "LEARN HOW WE MANAGED PERSONAL INFORMATION" right

usage: Use for a section intro statement with a large heading opposite supporting copy and a call-to-action link.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any heading-left / copy-right teaser without images. Use columns-media when one side is an image.
